result.description: A fictional ultra-wide display designed for color-critical design suites and collaborative dashboards. The Nebula Arc pairs a curved IPS panel with a 3440x1440 resolution, 165Hz refresh rate, and integrated USB-C docking for laptops and workstations. Its matte anti-glare coating and factory-calibrated DCI-P3 profile make it suited to creative workflows, while the built-in KVM switch and dual speakers reduce desk clutter.
